purpose: Teach: 櫃/鷯/豺/厘/平蔵/少佐/空海/膣

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、櫃、つまり伝統長持の復刻商品を企画しろ
lines.en: I want you to plan a revival line for us — traditional chests. Wooden storage chests, the kind that last centuries.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike opening. Direct command on the verb. Brief pause after the dash for the clarification to land. No inflection — this is procedure, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。鷯、つまり野鳥保護のCSR活動を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward with our CSR initiative — specifically, wild bird conservation work.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. A beat of processing before the clarification. Professional tone, showing he's tracking the assignment. No flourish — just confirming receipt and next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、豺、つまり野犬対策の地域協議に参加しろ
lines.en: And I want us in that regional council on stray dog management. Direct our participation there.
lines.style: Same clipped authority as the first line. Slight weight on the command verb. Expectation of compliance without needing to justify. Cool, measured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。単価を一厘単位、つまり厘までの管理に切り替えます
lines.en: Yes. We'll switch over to unit pricing in rin — the smallest traditional denomination — for tighter inventory control.
lines.style: Methodical recitation. Slight formality on the technical term. Shows he understands the precision being asked for. Steady, no hesitation — he's already thinking through implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、鬼平、つまり鬼の平蔵にちなんだ和食ブランドを出せ
lines.en: Launch a Japanese cuisine brand for us — inspired by Onihei, the legendary swordsman. Onihei's name, Onihei's story.
lines.style: Imperious but not hostile. The dash sets up the historical reference like context he's already decided matters. Command on the verb. Brief, expectant silence after.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退役少佐、つまり旧軍少佐の方の講演会を企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange a speaking engagement with a retired military officer — a former Imperial Army major — to represent that heritage.
lines.style: No hesitation. Direct acknowledgment, then moves into the specifics with quiet professionalism. Shows he's matching the magnitude of the assignment. Calm, capable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、空海ゆかりの観光商品を企画しろ
lines.en: And develop a tourism product line tied to Kobo Daishi's legacy. Something that honors his connection to our region.
lines.style: Similar authority, but slightly less harsh than the earlier directives. A hint that this one matters personally to him. Command at the end, but delivered with conviction rather than urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。女性用ケア商品で膣、つまり膣ケア製品の市場調査をします
lines.en: Noted. For our women's wellness line, I'll conduct market research on intimate care products — specialized feminine hygiene.
lines.style: Professional closing. Slight formality on the medical term, delivered matter-of-factly. No awkwardness — he's treating this like any other category. Steady, efficient conclusion.
